{{Top|leg}}
An '''electro-pick''' was a piece of technology used to bypass [[Lock/Legends|locks]]. It worked by cutting through the physical lock itself. [[Mair Koda]] used an electro-pick to cut through a locked door into the trainee barracks at the [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp]] when trying to rescue her foster brother, [[Kristoff Stonelaw]].<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
